header: Diddy Kong Racing's extended plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, at most 5 minutes with every timeout
counted, for when a longer play than the regular one (web/play_plan.json) is needed: the launcher, Load ROM 6 s after
it is up (the page starts RT64 only once it has the ROM, so the launcher builds no shaders and says nothing to wait
for), the logos to the title (shader_survey.js's titleReached(), a need), the menus to a new Adventure as a player
picks it (Enter, then A until the game is in Timber's Island, a need that the game is playing there) and the hub
driven about 15 s (roam()). Then three races in other worlds, reached the way the game's own teleport to Future Fun
Land loads a map (go(), since a player gets to them only by winning the races before; each a need that the map loaded
with its racers), driven toward each checkpoint: maps 5 and 13 about 30 s, in Dino Domain and Snowflake Mountain, and
map 10 about 20 s, in Sherbet Island.
play: (() => { const s = dkrState(); return s.mode === 0 && !s.loading && s; })()
